title: Turnagain Arm Muddy Tidelands ATV Adventure
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness
Please specify if you are a passenger or driver. Drivers 15 years old & older, Passengers 6 years old & older.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: An exhilarating ATV ride awaits you on the muddy tidelands of Turnagain Arm, where smooth, high-visibility trails lead through stunning landscapes. Navigate streams and mudflats on this advanced adventure, rated 'High' for difficulty. Expect to encounter wildlife such as moose and coyotes while traversing grassy meadows en route to Seattle Creek, with routes adjusted according to the tides. Set off from the Skookum Adventure Basecamp and prepare for the thrill of muddy terrain, where the harder you ride, the muddier you get. Dress warmly and embrace this unique Alaskan experience.
